title: Odometer Digit Chains
brief: A fleet telemetry unit stores very large distance counters as chains of single decimal digits, with the least significant digit at the head of the chain, because that is the digit that changes most often. The server needs to combine two such counters into one.

Implement addDigitChains(l1, l2), where l1 and l2 are ListNode chains holding the digits of two non-negative counters, least significant digit first, and return a ListNode chain in the same format holding their sum.
